The league started on 27 June 2026 and will conclude on 22 May 2027. [[FC Petrocub Hîncești|Petrocub Hîncești]] are the defending champions. The winners of the league this season will earn a spot in the [[2027–28 UEFA Champions League#First qualifying round|first qualifying round]] of the [[2027–28 UEFA Champions League]], the second and the third placed clubs will earn a place in the [[2027–28 UEFA Conference League#First qualifying round|first qualifying round]] of the [[2027–28 UEFA Conference League]].{{Cite web |url=https://fmf.md/noutate/17106/comitetul-executiv-din-24-aprilie|title=Comitetul Executiv din 24 aprilie|work=fmf.md}}{{cite news|title=UEFA Country Ranking 2026|url=https://kassiesa.net/uefa/data/method5/crank2026.html|work=kassiesa.net}}{{cite news|title=Totalurile sezonului|url=https://fmf.md/noutate/17467/liga-7777-totalurile-sezonului-20252026-cine-a-jucat-si-a-marcat|access-date=27 May 2026|publisher=fmf.md|language=ro}} ==Teams== ===Stadiums and locations=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" |- !
